description: Stored cybersecurity-digest preferences at ~/.cybersecurity-digest/config.json. Schema defaults are not applied by the current preparation runtime; scheduling and dual delivery are not implemented.

language.description: Editorial language preference. Set explicitly: the existing prepare CLI falls back to en if config is absent.

intervalDays.description: Requested three-calendar-day cadence; stored preference only, not yet scheduled or consumed by the runtime.

timezone.description: Requested timezone; stored preference only, not yet scheduled or consumed by the runtime.

deliveryTime.description: Requested local delivery time; stored preference only, not yet scheduled or consumed by the runtime.

frequency.description: Existing runtime reads this field. Neither value implements a three-day cadence; do not use it to activate this pilot.

delivery.description: One delivery method per explicit run. X Article has a local adapter; Telegram plus X Article dual delivery and scheduling are not implemented.

method.description: Single-channel delivery method. X Article requires an explicit title and runtime user-auth token; it has no verified live publication.

chatId.description: Telegram destination if method is telegram.

email.description: Email destination if method is email; not selected for this pilot.

title.description: Reviewed nonempty title required when method is x-article; text is supplied separately.
